query: Which concrete algorithms and monitoring metrics (importance weighting, target-proportion estimation, class-balanced pseudo-labeling) best detect and mitigate label-shift during adaptation?

response.query: Which concrete algorithms and monitoring metrics (importance weighting, target-proportion estimation, class-balanced pseudo-labeling) best detect and mitigate label-shift during adaptation?
response.answer: Importance weighting and class-balanced pseudo-labeling effectively detect and mitigate label-shift during adaptation. Target-proportion estimation also helps in maintaining model accuracy under label-shift.
